current_projection_assumption: Events were sorted by request_observed_ns, then round IDs in that chronological order were required to equal [1,2,...,R]

runtime_findings.logical_public_slot_identifier: X-AgentTool-Public-Slot is parsed into RelayPublicEvent.Round and range-checked against the public profile
runtime_findings.physical_send_order: The scheduler independently submits public HTTP/2 slots near their deadlines
runtime_findings.http2_transport: Multiple slot streams may be concurrently in flight and later requests are not blocked by an earlier delayed response
runtime_findings.application_handler_observation: request_observed_ns is captured at ServeHTTP entry before request validation and forwarding
runtime_findings.event_record_append_order: The event is mutex-appended only after response WriteHeader/Write, so append order is response-completion order
runtime_findings.export_order: Events() sorts a copy by public session and round for structural export while retaining raw timestamps
